name: eight-queens-visualizer
description: Interactive Eight Queens Puzzle Visualizer with Backtracking in Electron
author: Antigravity

scripts.app: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:electron
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run build:electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.electron:preview: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder
